current_date: April 2026 (cover date of the current version; para 1.1 says the list was first adopted in April 2022)
current_evidence: The council's 'What you need to submit with your planning application' page (last updated 27 April 2026) links this PDF as the 'National and local list', and the document cover reads 'APRIL 2026'.

issues.detail: The workbook dates the list 2022-04-01 and marks it 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes'. That uses the original adoption date in para 1.1. The linked document is the April 2026 version: its cover is dated April 2026, it includes 2024-onward content such as statutory BNG, and the council's planning page was updated in April 2026. So the list is current, not outdated.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'Telford and Wrekin Local Validation List, APRIL 2026'; para 1.1: 'was adopted in April 2022'

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none)', but the source has three Householder checklists with local items: Ecological Survey and Report; Climate Change Checklist; Flood Risk Assessment; Heritage Statement; Land Stability Declaration Form and Report; Photographs/Photomontages; and Tree Survey/Arboricultural Implications, including a shadowing plan. Householder 2 (conservation area) and Householder 3 (with LBC) add Other Technical Information Relating to Heritage Assets, and Householder 3 also adds a Structural Survey.
issues.evidence: Section 2 Validation checklists: Householder 1, Householder 2, Householder 3

issues.detail: Many local requirements in Section 5 do not appear anywhere in Grokbot's rows. They are: Affordable Housing Statement (major development or rural exception sites); Air Quality Assessment (major development or likely air-quality impact); Ecological Survey and Report (possible impact on wildlife or habitats); Coal Mining Risk Assessment (all non-householder applications in Coal Mining Referral Areas); Economic Statement (loss or creation of non-residential uses, or major development); Foul Sewage and Utilities Assessment (foul drainage not going to the public sewer, or trade waste); Homes for All Compliance Template (all major residential development); Land Contamination Assessment (known or suspected contamination); Landfill Statement (landfilling or landraising with waste); Land Stability Declaration Form and Report (Ironbridge Gorge zones 3, 4 or 5, significant excavation needing retaining structures, or known stability issues); Nationally Described Space Standard Compliance Template (where new dwellings are proposed); Parking Provision (development needing parking, or changes to it); Planning Statement (all major applications); Private Amenity Space Standards Compliance Template (major development); Self-Build/Custom-Build House Form (where new dwellings are proposed); Site Waste Management Plan (new residential or commercial development needing bin collection); Statement of Community Involvement (where pre-application consultation took place); Telecommunication Development Supplementary Information (masts and antennas); Transport Assessment/Statement and Travel Plan (significant transport implications); Other Technical Information Relating to Heritage Assets; and Climate Change Checklist (change of use and/or new development). The Climate Change Checklist appears only as a tab item, with no app-type row.
issues.evidence: Section 5 'Document types, content and templates', e.g. NDSS: 'To be provided where new dwellings are proposed'; Coal Mining: 'all non-householder applications within the Coal Mining Referral Areas'

issues.detail: Outline, Reserved matters, Permission in principle, Change of use prior approval, Demolition in cons area, Variation of condition s73, Discharge of conditions and Non-material amendment are all '(none)', but the source has a checklist for each. Outline 1-3 (outline and reserved matters) list about 33 local items, the same set as Full Planning. PiP Stage 2 matches Full Planning 1. Prior Notification/Approval 1 (change of use) lists Detailed Drawings, Ecological Survey, Daylight/Sunlight, FRA, Land Contamination, NDSS template, Noise, Parking, Structural Survey and Transport Statement. Relevant Demolition 1 lists Ecology, Land Stability, Other Heritage Information, Photographs, Planning Statement, Site Waste Management Plan, Structural Survey, Tree Survey and Heritage Statement. Removal/Variation of Conditions, Approval of Conditions and Non-Material Amendments each ask for relevant supporting information or annotated drawings.
issues.evidence: Section 2: Outline 1/2/3, Permission in Principle Stage 2, Prior Notification/Approval 1-4, Relevant Demolition 1, Removal or Variation of Conditions 1, Approval of Conditions 1, Non-Material Amendments 1

issues.detail: Advertisement consent is '(none)', but Advertisement Consent 1 requires Detailed Drawings, Heritage Statement, Lighting Assessment and Photographs, and Advertisement Consent 2 (with listed building consent) adds further heritage items. Listed building consent has only DAS and Lighting rows, but LBC checklist 1 requires Ecological Survey, Land Stability, Other Technical Information Relating to Heritage Assets, Photographs, Planning Statement, Structural Survey and Heritage Statement.
issues.evidence: Section 2: Advertisement Consent 1 and 2; Listed Building Consent 1

issues.detail: Every Full planning row is flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', even though the source has an explicit Full Planning 1 checklist, and the same items also apply to Outline/RM and PiP stage 2, which Grokbot left empty. Some rows are clearly misplaced. 'Lighting Assessment' sits under Listed building consent only because its trigger mentions the vicinity of a listed building, but LBC checklist 1 does not include it, while Full, Outline and Advertisement checklists do. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' and 'Structural Survey' are placed only under Full planning but relate mainly to listed building or demolition works.
issues.evidence: Section 2 Listed Building Consent 1 list (no Lighting Assessment); Advertisement Consent 1 includes Lighting Assessment

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments, guidance text or contain PDF page headers, not the actual threshold. Flood Risk Assessment: 'on site-specific flood risk assessments.' (actual trigger is all development in Flood Zones 2/3, plus Zone 1 sites of 1ha or more or in critical drainage areas). Drainage Strategy/SuDS: FRA content text with the header '5 42 5 Telford & Wrekin Council...' (actual SuDS Proforma trigger is 'proposals for residential or employment development'). Noise: 'A noise impact assessment may be required.' Planning Obligations: pre-app process text. Structural Survey: 'proposals with structural surveys or timber condition reports' (actual trigger is substantial demolition, conversion, or TPO works for structural reasons). Block plan: points to guidance only. Heritage Statement: describes format, not when it is needed. Ventilation/Extraction, Fire Statement and Existing/proposed levels include page headers. The BNG excerpt is cut off mid-sentence and omits the exemptions (householder, de minimis, self-build).
issues.evidence: Section 5 Threshold/trigger boxes, e.g. SuDS Proforma: 'To be provided with proposals for residential or employment development.'

issues.detail: The tab items under 'Submission rules' are download-link labels ('Download the ... proforma (.pdf Size: 376Kb)'), process text ('application can be submitted in hard copy or electronically'), FAQ boilerplate about redacting personal details, and the validation-dispute FAQ heading, not requirements. The drawing-standards item 'Telford & Wrekin Council - Telford & Wrekin Local Validation List 33 4 National Requirements Include a North point' contains a page header. The app-type row 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is advice about pre-app, not a validation requirement, and the 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' and DAS rows are national, not local, requirements.
issues.evidence: Section 3 Frequently Asked Questions paras 3.14-3.20; Section 4 National Requirements

issues.detail: Works to trees rows label the Trees 1 'Tree Report' as 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment / Tree Survey' and leave out 'Tree replacement details'. The excerpt runs on into the Trees 2 checklist text and is cut off ('...whose diameter does not exceed 100mm is for th'). The Tree Survey/Arboricultural Implications item applies to Trees 3 (hedgerow removal) and to development checklists, not TPO works.
issues.evidence: Section 2: Trees 1 - Photographs; Tree Report; Tree replacement details. Trees 3 - Photographs; Tree Survey/Arboricultural Implications; Ecological Survey

summary: Grokbot links the current April 2026 Telford list but dates it to the 2022 original adoption and wrongly flags it as outdated. Its extraction is thin: most of the roughly 37 local requirements and all the per-application-type checklists (Householder, Outline/RM, LBC, Advertisement, Prior Approval, etc.) are missing, and many triggers are garbled fragments.
